Entries.Title: Changes in version 3.0.0
Entries.Description:
A massive application interface upgrade has come! Latest design guidelines, new features and requested improvements are available.

In you encounter any issues or glitches feel free to reach me on email or GitHub - links are in the app preferences!
Messages: Align app look and feel to latest Material Design 3 guidelines.
Add support for landscape orientation and screen rotation.
Add option to follow system theme and react to system changes.
Apply app theme without restarting the app.
Add option to show the app on the lock screen (like navigation apps).
Improve support for resizing the app in split-screen mode.
Fix Optimized background battery usage not detected correctly.
Update external libraries.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.19.2
Messages: Fix Snackbar background and text color contrast when mixing light and dark app and system themes.
Fix crash when starting Collector on Android 12+ when running in the background.
Improve error handling.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.19.1
Messages: Fix the need to trigger intended action once more when the storage path wasn't granted in advance.
Add option to navigate to the last measurement location when coordinates are clicked on the Last measurement tab.
Add option to share coordinates of the center of the map from the Map tab.
Improve presentation of storage path.
Update external libraries.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.19.0
Entries.Description: Welcome [@t0stbrot.net](https://t0stbrot.net/) as new project to which you can contribute from your location anonymously. It's a recently established project which warmly welcomes new contributors. It's enabled by default so feel free to contribute!
Messages: Add @t0stbrot.net as new contribution project.
Fix GPS status not updated immediately when the location is obtained.
Replace toast notification with snackbar with Stop action when another task is currently running in background.
Update translations.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.18.0
Messages: Improve compatibility with Android 17 and 16.
Hide 'Project support' link on Google Play's app version.
Update external libraries.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.4
Messages: Fix application crash on startup.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.3
Messages: Update background location permission rationale to satisfy Google Play Prominent Disclosure requirement.
